newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were generally stable in late trading on Monday with market sentiment improving in line with better demand, traders said.
They said Singapore dealers bought rubber at 48.125 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang for August shipment, but there were no details on the quantity. Offer prices were generally stable in other centres.
"Offer prices were unchanged in other centres. Generally, traders are quite pleased because of this bullish trend. I expect to strike some more deals tomorrow," said one trader.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 48.50 cents fob Medan, 48.25 fob Palembang, 48.00 Padang and Surabaya and 47.75 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
